title: Check an agreement against a checklist, assembled
sub: One call per checklist rule, each seeing only that rule and the agreement; code checks every quote before anyone sees the list.

steps.h: The agreement and the checklist arrive
steps.d:
15-clause invented services agreement
6 rules: payment_terms, liability_cap, notice_period,
assignment, governing_law, data_deletion

steps.h: payment_terms answers alone, in parallel with the other five
Your code checks payment_terms's quote against clause 5
steps.d: quote is a verbatim substring of clause 5 -> kept as drafted

steps.h: Your code checks assignment's quote against clause 12
steps.d: quote is a verbatim substring of clause 12 -> kept as drafted

steps.h: Your code merges all six findings, quote-checked against their own clause
steps.d:
payment_terms breach (5) · liability_cap meets (9) · notice_period meets (7)
assignment breach (12) · governing_law unclear (13) · data_deletion missing (none)
steps.m: 6 of 6 findings verified against their cited clause

steps.d:
4 need a person: payment_terms, assignment, governing_law, data_deletion
2 cleared, no action needed: liability_cap, notice_period

steps.h: A person reads all six findings and decides
steps.d:
sees: every finding, its clause number and its quote
decides: acknowledged
